manifestations.description: on and off pain in the base of the right thumb
the pain increased when there were changes of weather; repeated use of the hand at work
pain and weakness when she tired to grasp large objects
when carrying objects by the side, there was pain in the palm and other fingers
difficulty in lifting heavy objects above the chest level
stiffness of the fingers with clumsiness in using chopsticks
could not fully fold up her right hand into a full grip
pain at the left side of the neck, left elbow radiating to the left forearm
numbness in the left fourth and fifth fingers

treatments_received: closed reduction of dislocation of hand and finger
open reduction of fracture of phalanges of hand with internal fixation
removal of the implanted plates from the carpals and metacarpals
Department of Integrated Rehabilitation Services (Occupational Therapy)
treatments_future: fusion operation for residual subluxation of the 1st CMCJ
psychiatric treatment (sessions and medication as recommended)

losses.description: Residual stiffness and pain in the right (dominant) hand with reduced grip, inability to fully fold right hand into a full grip, difficulty lifting heavy objects and clumsiness in using chopsticks.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Plaintiff alleged she could still carry out lighter household chores but not without difficulties; claim for global award of $200,000 was not proved and no award was made.
Plaintiff who became a skilled baker had to give up a job which she enjoyed; award made under this head.

comparable_cases.injury_description: Right dominant hand crushed; amputation of distal joint of ring finger; partial loss of grip and reduction in ability to lift heavy objects; multiple contusions; scalp lacerations leaving scars; psychiatric disorders.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lo Chi Bun v Leung Wah Kwan
comparable_cases.injury_description: Deep cut over dorsum of right (dominant) hand with disruption of MCP joint, fracture of proximal phalanx of ring and little fingers, complete cut of extensor tendons to middle, ring and little fingers; 5 to 6 operations; very poor grip.
